subject: Proposed 3-Year Prepay: phased consumption & billing cadence
messages:
From: Samir Desai <samir@atlasmed.io>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@atlasmed.io>
Date: 2026-01-12T09:14:00-08:00
Subject: Multi-year prepay interest — AtlasMed (usage forecast attached)

Ben —

Thanks for taking the time last week. Per our conversation, we're evaluating a 3-year committed plan with Redwood and I attached our internal usage forecast (see AtlasMed_usage_forecast.xlsx). A few things we're trying to lock down before we move to PO: 

- Discounting profile across a 3-year commitment (how does discount progress as we ramp?)
- Billing cadence and ability to split invoicing across years (we prefer some flexibility in cashflow)
- True-up mechanics if we under/over use against committed units
- Any performance/SLA credit language tied to this price

Can you share a concrete term proposal with a phased ramp assumption (we expect Year 1 ~60% of forecast, Year 2 ~85%, Year 3 ~100%) and the invoice timing options? If you can include a draft term sheet we can circulate to procurement, that would be great.

Appreciate it — aim is to get commercial terms sorted this month.

—Samir
Samir Desai
Head of Platform Ops, AtlasMed
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Samir Desai <samir@atlasmed.io>
Cc: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@atlasmed.io>
Date: 2026-01-12T11:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Multi-year prepay interest — AtlasMed (usage forecast attached)

Samir —

Thanks for the forecast, that helps a lot. Attached is a first-pass term sheet (redwood_3yr_term_sheet_v2.pdf) that maps to the ramp you described and a pricing profile we can stand behind. High-level proposal: 

- Commitment: 3-year prepay, annual invoicing at each year start (customer may elect to prepay multiple years up front for additional cash discount).
- Phased coverage (applied to committed units): Year 1 = 60% coverage, Year 2 = 85% coverage, Year 3 = 100% coverage.
- Pricing/Discounting: 18% off list token price for Year 1, 24% for Year 2, 30% for Year 3 (effective blended discount across 3 years ~24%).
- True-up: 30-day true-up window after each year. Overages billed at the contracted effective price. Underutilization can be applied as credit to the following year up to the committed term (no refunds).
- Billing: Standard is invoice at the start of each year for the full-year commitment. Alternate option: annual split (50/50) for Year 1 only, subject to finance approval.
- SLA: Standard platform SLA applies; additional SLA credits (for latency/availability) available up to a capped amount equal to 5% of annual prepay for material outages, per section 7 of the term sheet.

Two asks from our side: 1) keep the pricing confidential; 2) agree to the 30-day true-up window. 

If this direction looks good, I can loop in finance and legal for procurement redlines and get an approved offer letter. Note: I’ve included Lena and her procurement team so we can move quickly.

I attached the term sheet. Happy to hop on a 30-min call to walk through details.

Best,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-01-13T08:47:00-08:00
Subject: Fw: AtlasMed — 3yr prepay proposal (approval request)

Marissa / Karthik —

Looping you in. AtlasMed (deal ATL-2026-003) wants a 3-year prepay with a phased ramp (60/85/100). I proposed discounts 18/24/30 (Y1/Y2/Y3). Attached is the term sheet I plan to send.

Key negotiation points: 
- They asked for split billing flexibility; I flagged finance but we should decide if we allow a Year 1 50/50 split for cashflow reasons.
- True-up is set at 30 days — normal for us but they may push for longer.
- SLA credits capped at 5% of annual prepay in the draft; procurement will push for higher.

Requesting 1) pricing authorization to commit to the 30% Y3 discount if they sign as-is, and 2) approval to offer a Year 1 split invoice (50/50) as a one-time concession if legal/finance okay with it.

I think the deal is strategic (big usage upside) — happy to discuss with numbers.

Thanks —
Ben
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-01-14T10:23:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Fw: AtlasMed — 3yr prepay proposal (approval request)

Ben —

Thanks for the summary. I approve a sanitized concession set with limits: 

- Approved pricing: up to 28% discount in Year 3 (do not commit to 30% without exec confirmation). Blended approval up to ~23% is fine.
- True-up: keep at 30 days. Procurement can request longer but we stand firm; allow a one-time extension to 45 days only if they provide a signed mutual action plan.
- Billing: allow Year 1 50/50 split as a commercial concession; finance to approve cashflow terms but do not allow split for Years 2/3.
- SLA credits: keep capped at 5% of annual prepay; legal to refuse any open-ended credit language.
- Usage floor: require a 60% usage floor for Year 1 (if usage <60%, apply shortfall credit mechanism per the term sheet).

Karthik — please flag to Legal & Finance the items above and confirm any system/process blockers for the 50/50 Year 1 split. If finance says no, revert to annual upfront invoicing.

Ben — once Legal signs off, send the updated term sheet to Samir and ask for signature by Jan 26 to lock pricing and capacity. If they need longer, we can reprice.

-Marissa
VP, Enterprise GTM
Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Samir Desai <samir@atlasmed.io>
Cc: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@atlasmed.io>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-01-19T16:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Multi-year prepay interest — AtlasMed (updated term sheet & next steps)

Samir —

Thanks — quick update after internal approvals. Attached is the updated term sheet (redwood_3yr_term_sheet_v2.pdf) reflecting negotiated limits. Key points (final):

- Commitment: 3-year prepay with phased coverage Year1=60%, Year2=85%, Year3=100%.
- Pricing: 18% / 24% / 28% (Y1/Y2/Y3). This is our approved floor; 28% Year 3 is the maximum we can offer without exec escalation.
- True-up: 30 days after each year; one-time extension to 45 days if they return a signed mutual action plan within 10 business days of signature.
- Billing: standard annual invoicing at start of each year. We will allow a one-time Year 1 50/50 split (subject to finance sign-off).
- SLA credits: capped at 5% of annual prepay; no open-ended credit commitments.
- Usage floor: 60% Year 1 floor; shortfall handled as credit per the term sheet.

If this is acceptable, please sign via the DocuSign link below. We ask for signature by 2026-01-26 to preserve pricing and the requested capacity. If you need more time, let me know and we can discuss a bridge or temporary hold on the pricing.
